profiling.timings: profiled trials excluded from speed claims
profiling.classification: Flink task thread names at p=1; Native node names distinguish native tasks; Source/GroupAggregate names distinguish stock tasks. Compiler, GC and control threads are excluded.
profiling.allocation_note: Java allocation weights are sampled allocation traffic, not peak memory or Rust/C/C++ allocation bytes. Native Rust request counters are separate.

native_criterion.boundary: production update and changelog materialization; setup, Arrow fixture construction, retract seeding and destruction outside timing
native_criterion.allocator_probe: untimed, thread-local Rust allocation request counts/full requested sizes, including full realloc requests; excludes native C/C++ allocations; output buffer sharing is not copied bytes
native_criterion.checkpoint_boundary: snapshot serialization and state restoration; input/state setup and output/state destruction outside timing; byte/state results have no Arrow output buffers to report

validation.recovery: eight JSON scenarios, two successive restores each, memory/native RocksDB, append/retract; specific operator consumption and released memory verified
